newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share volume leaps, Daugavpils leads.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share volume leaps, Daugavpils leads.

text.p: Latvian shares were busy on Tuesday as bourse volume leapt over 100,000 lats with secondary market share Daugavpils Chain leading the way as the most active stock.
Total turnover came to 111,189 lats versus Monday's 76,522 lats. Daugavpils chain traded 43,442 lats and gained three santimes to 2.14 lats.
On the main official list Riga Transport Fleet was the most traded on business of 22,163 lats as it rose two santimes to 1.63 lats.
Usual market leader Unibanka saw 12,220 lats of shares change hands but remained stable at 3.25 lats.
